authority: Codex root personally owns workflow selection, contribution hypothesis and evidence acceptance
scope: User resumed bounded problem framing through the three requested deliverables. No authorization is inferred for new production RTL, FPGA builds or board runs.

workflow.name: Sobel line-prefetch traffic with an independent background DMA copy stream
workflow.primary_source: DASH section2.2, 640x480 at30fps, four640-byte lines, three consumed and one prefetched
workflow.adaptation: DID10 copies frame rows to four logical line slots; a deterministic consumer releases the oldest slot. DID11 independently copies4KiB blocks around separate16-page source and destination rings. Shared IOMMU and backing-service contention are proposed study conditions, not facts from the DASH Sobel example.
fixed_requirements: 640bytes per row; exact period625000/9 ns or31250/9 cycles at50MHz
Frame source exists and is immutable; all descriptor addresses and deadlines are available to every policy at time0
Payload destination slot cannot be overwritten while consumed; address knowledge and advance translation are not prohibited by that payload constraint
Fixed destinations; no multicast, interchangeable outputs, late-bound destination requirement or cancellation of accepted bus transactions
Static S1 mappings for the initial contract; real faults/invalidation must never be ignored in a later implementation

Release constrains first destination payload write, not descriptor launch, legal advance translation or pre-read; any staging cost must be counted equally. Completion means data consumable, not merely translation granted.
workflow.scope_limit: A task generator and completion-contract checker, not implemented Sobel compute, a memory-timing simulator, a board port or full-frame FPS evidence

actual_gap_judgment.supported_old_observation: Existing A8 V64 copy/gap0 board records show PN V-window+12.85percent and A rate-11.39percent relative to P; P itself removes that disadvantage.
actual_gap_judgment.unsupported_transfer: Neither this percentage nor old per-copy averages measure a remaining gap for the new line-buffer workflow or its deadlines.
actual_gap_judgment.new_workflow_gap: Unmeasured. No positive deficit against the strongest legal simple policies has been established; this is not proof that the deficit is zero.
actual_gap_judgment.decisive_simple_control: 307200-byte aligned frame fits in one2MiB mapping and2560-byte line ring in one4KiB mapping. Under legal contiguous allocation, static S1/no invalidation and retained translations, two leaf translations cover V. This is mapping geometry, not proof of zero total interference or that the current benchmark already maps hugepages.
actual_gap_judgment.implementation_boundary: Current composition ABI fixes4KiB copies and completion-relative gap. It has no consumer/free-slot/deadline semantics. Current driver prepares PAGE_SIZE mappings; 2MiB IOTLB matching exists, but large-page benchmark setup is not already implemented.

frozen_controls: B0: trained fixed mapping/cache protection plus background quota, including no partition and legal hugepage/preparation alternatives
B1: DASH-style deadline/progress scheduling plus source admission and paid drain/translation preparation; same early metadata as candidate
B2: whole-critical-copy reservation, with background resumed at actual completion, allowing legal advance preparation

hypothesis.statement: For this fixed line-prefetch workload, observing the current remaining translation work and committed service obligations may allow a shorter background-protection window than conservative fixed bounds, preserving all line deadlines while increasing useful background completions relative to the frozen controls after overhead.
hypothesis.proposed_information: Per-copy source/destination translation progress associated with the real request and context, plus bounded outstanding obligations; raw TLB residency is not a permission grant or a guaranteed future hit
hypothesis.proposed_action: Change only when to stop admitting new background copies and when to resume. Honor all published/accepted AXI obligations; do not silently alter P/N mode while busy.
hypothesis.status: A falsifiable screening hypothesis, not an accepted independent innovation. Merely adding PTW latency to DASH, forwarding a priority or reusing old p5 under a new name is insufficient.
failure_conditions: Any legal simple control achieves the same deadline/background/cost frontier
Legal hugepages/preparation eliminate the supposedly needed translation information
Observation or control cost removes the background gain
Predicted protection window causes deadline or protocol failure
Benefit requires arbitrarily denying baselines early metadata, advance translation or legal storage
negative_cases: V translations already retained and the line deadline is loose
Translation contribution is negligible relative to data service

decision: Fix the workflow and comparison contract; do not advance a new hardware method on the current evidence. The missing quantitative gap is the next decision, not a number to infer from old PN slowdown.
execution_policy: Generate and validate only the small workflow contract in out; no invented performance samples, full-platform model, production change, build or board execution. Record actual checks separately.
record_role: Supplemental concrete workflow instance for the fixed-destination COPY main line; does not replace the concurrent research-convergence-20261010 plan.
baseline_execution_status: Rules and equal permissions specified; workflow scheduling implementations and timing results are not yet available. Do not report that B0/B1/B2 have been executed.
